author: Michael Hanich
title: Second person charged with murder in 2025 shooting death in Milton - NewsBreak
text:
By Michael Hanich ,
1 hours ago Video above: ‘News 5 Now’ — Top Stories from Aug. 12, 2026
MILTON, Fla. (WKRG) — The Milton Police Department made a second arrest for a deadly shooting back in November 2025.
Jerry Carl wins GOP nomination in Alabama’s District 1 Special Congressional race According to a news release, officers charged Jacari Michael Wright on Wednesday, Aug. 12, with murder – dangerous depraved without premeditation.
Mugshot of Jacari Wright (Courtesy of the Santa Rosa County Sheriff’s Office) Police said this incident stems from the shooting death of Tervon Jackson on Nov. 24, 2025, at Lucille Johnson Park on Mary Street in Milton.
Officials said Jackson, Wright and other people were arguing, which led to gunshots.
Jackson died on the scene.
People said after the shooting, Wright ran away near Pine Street and Elmira Street. Two guns were reportedly found in the swamp area where Wright was discovered.
Investigators said surveillance footage, other evidence and witness statements connected Wright to the incident.
Officials previously arrested Jayden Wright on Nov. 25, 2025 , and charged him with murder. Investigators said Jacari and Jayden Wright are brothers.
